findings.title: Web query failures can resolve as successful empty results
findings.trigger: Query a missing source or request a rendered query restricted to a nonexistent layer
findings.behavior: The adapters normalize the returned [] as success. MapLibre source queries return [] for a missing source; both web renderers emit an error and return [] for a missing rendered-query layer.
findings.impact: Callers cannot distinguish empty data from invalid query targets, contrary to the query failure contract
findings.recommendation: Preflight supported loaded sources and requested layers; propagate query-scoped renderer failures; add missing-source and missing-layer rejection regressions

findings.title: Loading-style unmount abandons owned images on reusable maps
findings.trigger: Register an image, make isStyleLoaded false, then unmount and reuse the same renderer and style
findings.behavior: Cleanup removes its listeners and returns before removing images. The next Images session has an empty ownership map and cannot remove the abandoned image.
findings.impact: Stale images survive logical unmount and can leak into subsequent maps
findings.recommendation: Release image ownership across loading-style unmounts, using safe removal or bounded renderer-scoped deferred cleanup that cannot remove a replacement owner's image; add a loading-style unmount/reuse regression
basis: Pinned react-map-gl reuse retains renderer; style update skips unchanged mapStyle

findings.title: Web interactive updates do not control existing handlers
findings.trigger: Change interactive true -> false after mounting, or enable an individual gesture while interactive is false
findings.behavior: The facade forwards interactive without deriving handler flags. The pinned wrappers update individual handler props and do not update handlers from interactive.
findings.impact: Interaction stays enabled after being disabled, and individual props can override the master disabled state
findings.recommendation: Map interactive=false onto the individual web handler props with defined reset semantics; add master-flag update, combined-flag, and reuse regressions
basis: Both pinned react-map-gl _updateHandlers implementations executed with fake handlers and actual facade conversion
MapProps.interactive and TF04 documented portable interaction contract

diagnosis: Pinned RNMapbox and MapLibre React Native source attachment can adopt an existing same-id SDK source; a keyed React remount does not ensure native state reset.

Atomic smoke transitions and rendered/source revision sentinels prevent querying attaching MapLibre Fabric tags or accepting prior-source data. Both attaching and retiring tags can be unavailable; the earlier invalid-tag error alone does not distinguish them.
MapLibre refreshes imperative source handles on render; passive registration previously captured an earlier handle.
implementation: NativeFeatureState remembers facade-written identifiers only, serializes per-source calls, and resets whole state after fully rendered frames or before replacement state operations, ordered after pending old writes. Automatic resets coalesce; failures report once through onError and block later state calls until a new lifetime or style.
GeoJSON and vector lifetimes register in layout effects with owner-bound cleanup; MapLibre dispatch reads current source handles.

Detached or replaced operations reject; reset errors block further state dispatch for that lifetime and another remount can retry. Caller identifiers and nested validated state are copied before queueing.
Smoke scene changes are atomic; revision sentinels prove replacement data readiness; whole-state assertions detect retained secondary keys. No explicit smoke state clear or broad invalid-tag retry.
